note: Small RV park in Moncure near Jordan Lake (a boat ramp within half a mile) and the Jordan Dam, 45 min to an hour from Durham and Chapel Hill; shaded gravel sites, cable at most sites for an extra fee, a fish-feeding pond (no fishing). No tents. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: 20 sites, 30/50-amp full hookups, open year-round, reservations required by phone with a half deposit. Cleared the note-derived 50-ft max rig (not on the operator's pages). No rate is posted anywhere. Note trimmed of field values and corrected (Durham is 45 min-1 hr, not ~30 min; the 50-ft claim dropped).
flags: Long-stay / workforce park (for a human): the operator's pages post no nightly or any rate (test 2 fails: no posted nightly price, no booking engine), describe utilities as 'included in the monthly fee' (twice), and pitch 'a quiet, restful place after a long day', 'after your workday', 'after a long day at work'. Reads as a monthly workforce park; a nightly product is not shown.
No 2024+ rate from the operator; price gate unchecked (nearest gateway Raleigh 43 km, outside 40 km; the family has not stayed here). The site has no date on it.
Presence: operator website with phone (919) 868-0973 (matches), so it passes, but Google Maps shows only 5 reviews (5.0).
